summaryZh: Rohner 研究组结合进化发育生物学、进化生态学和遗传学，研究生物多样性如何产生并演化。团队聚焦昆虫，探索可塑性、发育偏向和生物—环境相互作用如何塑造表型及其进化；具体实验方法未明确。
researchQuestions: 生物多样性如何产生并演化？
在昆虫中，可塑性、发育偏向及生物与环境的相互作用如何塑造表型及其演化？

evidence.quote: Our group integrates concepts and approaches from evolutionary developmental biology, evolutionary ecology, and genetics to better understand how biological diversity arises and evolves. Focusing on insects, we are especially interested in how plasticity, developmental bias, and organism-environment interactions shape phenotypes and their evolution.
